leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the transition property to HTML elements to enable smooth visual changes
Configure transition duration values to control the speed of property changes
Implement transition timing functions to create different motion effects
Construct CSS rules with transition-delay to stagger when animations begin
Manipulate multiple properties simultaneously with comma-separated transition declarations
Initialize hover states with transitions to create interactive button effects
Integrate transitions with other CSS properties like color, background-color, and transform
